row.boundary_en: Using activations for calibration does not mean activations are compressed.
row.boundary_zh: 用于校准的激活统计不意味着压缩对象是激活。
row.description_en: Intermediate activations, including hidden states and visual-token representations. Cached K/V are tracked separately as KV Cache.
row.description_zh: 推理计算中的中间激活，包括隐藏状态与视觉 Token 的中间表示；作为后续步骤缓存的 K/V 单独归入 KV Cache。

row.boundary_en: Classification is an editorial research view; inspect the original mechanism and deployment conditions.
row.boundary_zh: 更小的存储不保证访问量同比下降。
row.description_en: Memory bandwidth
row.description_zh: 访问字节和带宽压力，区分权重读取与状态读写。

row.boundary_en: Classification is an editorial research view; inspect the original mechanism and deployment conditions.
row.boundary_zh: 报告额外尺度、索引、元数据、工作区和质量条件。
row.description_en: Memory capacity
row.description_zh: 参数、状态和瞬时张量的实际驻留字节及峰值。

row.boundary_en: Classification is an editorial research view; inspect the original mechanism and deployment conditions.
row.boundary_zh: 通信是成本维度；具体传输对象还须标记参数/激活/状态。
row.description_en: Communication cost
row.description_zh: 跨设备传输的数据量、编解码与同步成本。

row.boundary_en: Separate deployment of a native architecture from conversion of an existing checkpoint.
row.boundary_zh: 原生模型部署和改造既有检查点必须分开。
row.description_en: Follow the survey category Efficient Architecture Design. Record training/checkpoint-conversion requirements and preserve GQA, MQA and MLA as named designs.
row.description_zh: 沿用语言模型压缩综述的 Efficient Architecture Design 类别。结构改变须说明训练或检查点改造需求，具体 GQA、MQA、MLA 仍以原文名称登记。

row.boundary_en: Classification is an editorial research view; inspect the original mechanism and deployment conditions.
row.boundary_zh: 两段低秩矩阵乘或稀疏核可能增加调度成本。
row.description_en: Compute cost
row.description_zh: 实际执行的算术量与算子形状。

row.boundary_en: Distillation does not promise losslessness or guarantee a smaller or faster student. Feature matching alone does not establish activation or KV compression. Check student architecture changes, quality recovery and complete deployment cost separately.
row.boundary_zh: 蒸馏不承诺无损，也不保证学生一定更小或更快。特征匹配本身不证明激活或 KV 已压缩；应分开核对学生结构变化、质量恢复与完整部署成本。
row.description_en: Train a student using teacher outputs, features or other intermediate information to preserve task capability under student capacity or compute constraints. Distillation may combine with quantization, pruning and architectural changes. Compression follows the deployed student structure and representation; supervision helps recover quality.
row.description_zh: 利用教师模型的输出、特征或其他中间信息训练学生模型，研究在学生容量或计算受限时如何保留任务能力；可与量化、剪枝及结构改造结合。压缩由实际部署的学生结构和表示决定，监督用于帮助恢复质量。
row.map_caveat_en: A training method: compression depends on the deployed student; losslessness is not guaranteed.
row.map_caveat_zh: 属于训练方法；压缩收益取决于部署的学生模型，不保证无损。
row.map_notation_zh: 教师 → 监督 → 学生
row.map_summary_en: Train a student with teacher outputs or features to help a smaller model retain capability.
row.map_summary_zh: 用教师模型的输出或特征训练学生，帮助较小模型保留能力。

row.boundary_en: Classification is an editorial research view; inspect the original mechanism and deployment conditions.
row.boundary_zh: 训练梯度压缩不能未经审查计为推理通信压缩。
row.description_en: Distributed inference
row.description_zh: 多设备推理及跨设备数据交换场景。

row.boundary_en: Parameter-efficient low-rank adaptation is not deployed weight compression, and correction branches may add storage and compute. Factors must matter in actual execution; include full-matrix reconstruction, additional matrix products and scheduling overhead.
row.boundary_zh: 低秩适配训练不等于部署权重压缩；补偿支路也可能增加容量和计算。因子必须在实际执行中发挥作用，重构完整矩阵、额外矩阵乘与调度开销均需计入。
row.description_en: Approximate a matrix with lower-rank factors and study the trade-off between rank, approximation error and representation or computation cost. Distinguish weight factorization from low-dimensional approximations of intermediates such as attention; preserve paper-specific rank, training and reconstruction conditions.
row.description_zh: 用较低秩的因子近似原矩阵，研究秩、近似误差与表示或计算成本的折中。区分权重矩阵分解与注意力等中间量的低维近似，保留原文的秩选择、训练和重构条件。
row.map_caveat_en: Training with LoRA does not itself compress deployment; reconstruction cost also matters.
row.map_caveat_zh: 训练用的 LoRA 不等于部署压缩；还需计入重构开销。
row.map_summary_en: Approximate a matrix with smaller factors, balancing rank and approximation error.
row.map_summary_zh: 用较小的因子矩阵近似原矩阵，在秩与误差之间取舍。

row.boundary_en: Cache eviction, numerical compression and architectural changes are different interventions.
row.boundary_zh: 数值压缩、token 驱逐和原生架构减少缓存是不同机制。
row.description_en: Cached keys and values reused during autoregressive attention; distinguish quantization, pruning, low rank and eviction.
row.description_zh: 自回归注意力中缓存的 Key/Value，供后续生成复用。单独记录量化、剪枝、低秩及淘汰策略。

row.boundary_en: Sparse attention is not necessarily eviction; verify that cache entries are actually removed.
row.boundary_zh: 不把所有稀疏注意力都当作 KV 淘汰；必须核对是否实际移除缓存。
row.description_en: Select retained historical tokens and evict the remaining KV; record importance signals, budget allocation and prefill/decode timing.
row.description_zh: 按 KV 管理文献单列：选择保留的历史 Token，淘汰其余 KV；记录重要性信号、预算分配和 prefill/decode 时机。

row.boundary_en: Classification is an editorial research view; inspect the original mechanism and deployment conditions.
row.boundary_zh: 论文单算子加速不是业务端到端或昇腾实测结论。
row.description_en: Latency and throughput
row.description_zh: TTFT、TPOT、请求时延和吞吐，按固定模型及运行条件比较。

row.boundary_en: Do not generalize token merging into a universal mechanism for every tensor.
row.boundary_zh: 不将 Token 合并泛化为所有张量的统一“表示合并”机制。
row.description_en: Merge multiple token representations into fewer representations; current references include LLaVA-PruMerge and preserve its selection-plus-merging design.
row.description_zh: Token Merging：把多个 Token 表示合并为更少的表示；当前登记资料包含 LLaVA-PruMerge，按原文记录选择与合并的组合。

row.boundary_en: Classification is an editorial research view; inspect the original mechanism and deployment conditions.
row.boundary_zh: 图像 token 压缩不直接等于文本 KV 驱逐。
row.description_en: Multimodal workloads
row.description_zh: 视觉 token 与跨模态表征，实际对象仍须落到参数、激活或持久状态。
row.name_zh: 图像 / 视频等多模态

row.boundary_en: Activation statistics used for calibration do not make an algorithm activation compression; LoRA alone does not compress deployed weights.
row.boundary_zh: LoRA 的参数高效微调不自动压缩部署权重。
row.description_en: Inference weights, including embeddings, attention, FFN and expert weights.
row.description_zh: 模型推理使用的权重，包括嵌入、注意力、FFN 与专家权重。文献分类名称为 Weights。

row.boundary_en: KV papers do not establish compression results for recurrent or SSM state.
row.boundary_zh: KV 文献不能直接作为循环或 SSM 状态压缩的证据。
row.description_en: Historical non-KV state labels retained for traceability, outside the main map.
row.description_zh: 历史资料中的非 KV 状态标签，保留用于旧索引追溯；不作为当前主地图对象。

row.boundary_en: Record format, granularity, calibration, outlier handling and dequantization cost. INT and FP formats are not interchangeable by bit width. Low-bit storage does not guarantee end-to-end speedup; do not count joint gains repeatedly across targets.
row.boundary_zh: 同时记录格式、量化粒度、校准、离群值处理及反量化成本；INT 与 FP 不能按位宽直接互换。低比特存储不保证端到端加速，联合方案收益不按对象重复计算。
row.description_en: Represent weights, activations or KV cache with fewer bits while studying error and execution cost. Distinguish integer formats such as INT8/INT4 from floating-point formats such as FP8/FP4: equal bit width does not imply equal numerical range, scale organization or computation. Retain paper-specific PTQ, QAT, weight-only and joint weight–activation configurations.
row.description_zh: 用较少位数表示权重、激活或 KV Cache，并研究量化误差与执行成本。区分 INT8/INT4 等整数格式与 FP8/FP4 等浮点格式；相同位数不意味着相同数值范围、尺度组织或计算路径。按原文记录 PTQ、QAT、仅权重及权重—激活联合配置。
row.map_caveat_en: INT8 and FP8 have equal bit width but different numerical formats and compute support.
row.map_caveat_zh: INT8 与 FP8 位宽相同，数值格式与计算支持不同。
row.map_notation_zh: 较高位宽 → 较低位宽
row.map_summary_en: Use fewer bits per value for weights, activations or KV cache.
row.map_summary_zh: 减少每个数值的表示位数，压缩权重、激活或 KV Cache。

row.boundary_en: Coverage is limited; do not transfer KV results to recurrent or SSM state.
row.boundary_zh: 当前资料库覆盖有限，不将 KV 论文直接迁移为 SSM 结论。
row.description_en: Recurrent / SSM state
row.description_zh: 非 KV 的跨步模型状态，需要明确状态形状、更新方式和信息保真。

row.boundary_en: Sparsity describes structure or execution; pruning is one way to induce sparsity or shrink structures. Zeros or masks do not guarantee skipped computation. Sparse attention need not reduce KV capacity; distinguish cache eviction from parameter pruning.
row.boundary_zh: 稀疏是结构或执行特征，剪枝是形成稀疏或缩小结构的一类方法。置零或掩码不保证实际跳过计算；稀疏注意力不自动缩小 KV 缓存，KV 淘汰与参数剪枝分别辨认。
row.description_en: Reduce retained representations or executed work by removing or selecting parameters, channels, layers or tokens. Distinguish unstructured, semi-structured and structured pruning from input-dependent dynamic selection; retain the location, granularity and execution mechanism defined by each paper.
row.description_zh: 通过删减或选择参数、通道、层、Token 等，减少保留的表示或实际执行的工作。区分非结构化、半结构化、结构化剪枝与输入相关的动态选择，按原文说明稀疏位置、粒度和执行方式。
row.map_caveat_en: Zeros alone do not accelerate inference; execution must skip work.
row.map_caveat_zh: 置零不等于加速；需要实际跳过计算。
row.map_notation_zh: 稠密 → 稀疏 / 更小结构
row.map_summary_en: Remove parameters or structures, or compute with selected elements.
row.map_summary_zh: 删减参数或结构，或只让部分元素参与计算。

row.boundary_en: This attention architecture topic is not parameter sharing, prefix-cache deduplication or paging.
row.boundary_zh: 这是注意力架构专题，不等于参数共享、前缀缓存去重或分页管理。
row.description_en: Grouped-Query / Multi-Query Attention use fewer KV heads than query heads to reduce cache requirements; retain the architectural literature names.
row.description_zh: Grouped-Query Attention / Multi-Query Attention：多个 Query head 使用较少的 KV head，减少缓存需求；按注意力架构原文单列。

row.boundary_en: Classification is an editorial research view; inspect the original mechanism and deployment conditions.
row.boundary_zh: 声码器是其中的模型组件，权重和激活仍按对象分类。
row.description_en: Speech workloads
row.description_zh: 语音/音频业务场景。

row.boundary_en: Classification is an editorial research view; inspect the original mechanism and deployment conditions.
row.boundary_zh: 必须报告长度、批量、任务和检索质量。
row.description_en: Text and long context
row.description_zh: 文本生成、长上下文及 RAG 场景。

row.boundary_en: Classification is an editorial research view; inspect the original mechanism and deployment conditions.
row.boundary_zh: 不能与权重、KV 数据对象并列。
row.description_en: Vocoder component
row.description_zh: 语音生成模型中的一个组件，按具体参数与激活结构分析。
